blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian has underscored the need to strengthen cooperation as he expressed optimism that the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit will provide a robust platform to fast-track economic growth across the region. “By strengthening economic partnerships with Asean member states and dialogue partners, we can unlock new investments and create quality jobs that directly uplift ordinary families and help lift communities out of poverty across the region,” he said in a statement.
